    n, k = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    parents = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    parents.insert(0, 0)  # Make it 1-indexed

    depth = [0] * (n + 1)
    children = defaultdict(list)

    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        children[parents[i]].append(i)

    def dfs(node):
        if not children[node]:
            depth[node] = 1
            return 1
        max_depth = 0
        for child in children[node]:
            max_depth = max(max_depth, dfs(child))
        depth[node] = max_depth + 1
        return depth[node]

    dfs(1)

    visited_leaves = set()
    stack = [(1, k)]
    while stack:
        node, moves_up = stack.pop()
        if not children[node]:
            visited_leaves.add(node)
        else:
            for child in children[node]:
                stack.append((child, k))
            if moves_up > 0:
                parent = parents[node]
                if parent != 0 and depth[parent] >= depth[node] - k:
                    stack.append((parent, moves_up - 1))

    print(len(visited_leaves))
